sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY TO NY
sections.text: SRN FRINGE OF MID LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION DURING THE LATTER HALF OF THE DAY1 PERIOD IN ADVANCE OF AB/SK SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. MID LEVEL FLOW IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS ND INTO NRN MN BY LATE AFTERNOON WHICH SHOULD ENCOURAGE WEAK SFC LOW TO LIFT NEWD TOWARD THE ARROWHEAD OF MN BY 19/00Z. AS DEEP LAYER FLOW VEERS IT APPEARS THE STRONGEST CORRIDOR OF WARM ADVECTION WILL SHIFT TOWARD THE CANADIAN BORDER AND FOCUS OVER LAKE SUPERIOR. PRIOR TO THIS EVOLUTION ISOLATED-SCT CONVECTION SHOULD BE ONGOING AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD NEAR THE CANADIAN BORDER FROM NRN ND...SEWD INTO NRN WI. THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE ENHANCED BY VEERED LLJ THAT WILL GRADUALLY LIFT TOWARD LAKE SUPERIOR BY LATE AFTERNOON. EARLY DAY ACTIVITY COULD PRODUCE SOME HAIL OR PERHAPS EVEN GUSTY WINDS...HOWEVER MORE SIGNIFICANT CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR NEAR THE SFC LOW OVER MN AS SFC TEMPERATURES WARM TO NEAR 90F. WITH SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL VEERING THE MOST LIKELY ZONE FOR INTENSE UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT WILL OCCUR OVER NRN MN ALONG THE ADVANCING BOUNDARY...WEST OF THE COOL INFLUENCE OF LAKE SUPERIOR. FORECAST SOUNDINGS INVOF

sections.title: NY
sections.text: FLAT SHORT-WAVE RIDGING IS EXPECTED TO INFLUENCE MUCH OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO NY THURSDAY...ALTHOUGH A CORRIDOR OF 30-40KT MID LEVEL WNWLY FLOW WILL EXTEND ACROSS SRN ONTARIO INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND. DESPITE NEGLIGIBLE LARGE SCALE SUPPORT ALOFT...IT APPEARS DIURNAL HEATING SHOULD FORCE SFC TEMPERATURES QUICKLY INTO THE MID 80S ACROSS WRN/UPSTATE NY WHICH IS MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR BREACHING CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES. WITH DEW POINTS EXPECTED TO HOLD NEAR 70F AND PW VALUES ON THE ORDER OF 1.75 INCHES...ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP. MODEST WLY SHEAR SHOULD PROVE SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG MULTI-CELL UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING GUSTY WINDS AND PERHAPS EVEN SOME HAIL. THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE STRONGLY DIURNAL AND SHOULD WEAKEN WITH LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING.

sections.title: GULF COAST
sections.text: WWD MOVING SHORT-WAVE TROUGH SHOULD ADVANCE ACROSS AL INTO MS/LA DURING THE DAY. CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF CONVECTION DEVELOPED INVOF THIS FEATURE ACROSS SC/GA ON WEDNESDAY AND DAYTIME HEATING SHOULD AID NEW DEVELOPMENT DOWNSTREAM ACROSS MUCH OF SRN MS/LA INTO SERN TX BY MID DAY. ISOLATED WET MICROBURSTS ARE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WITH THIS CONVECTION.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: SCT CONVECTION WILL ONCE AGAIN DEVELOP ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN ROCKIES...NWD ACROSS CO INTO PORTIONS OF ERN WY/BLACK HILLS OF SD. NRN EXTENT OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL EVOLVE WITHIN WEAK UPSLOPE REGIME ALONG SRN FRINGE OF MODEST NWLY FLOW ALOFT. SOME WEAK ORGANIZATION MAY BE NOTED ACROSS THIS REGION AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND IS POSSIBLE WITH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING STORMS. ..DARROW/LEITMAN.. 07/18/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IN MID-UPPER LEVELS...DOMINANT FEATURE OVER MOST OF CONUS WILL REMAIN STG RIDGING FROM MID-ATLC/TIDEWATER REGIONS WWD ACROSS OH VALLEY TO GREAT BASIN...WITH ATTACHED HIGHS OVER OH VALLEY REGION AND UT. TO ITS S...BROAD/WEAK CYCLONE WAS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NERN GULF...CENTERED S OF FL PANHANDLE AND W OF CENTRAL FL AS OF 11Z. CENTRAL PORTION OF THIS FEATURE SHOULD MOVE NWWD TO WNWWD ACROSS N-CENTRAL GULF...REACHING LA COAST FROM ABOUT 06Z ONWARD. LONG-LIVED CYCLONE THAT MOVED SWWD FROM OH ACROSS OK NOW IS DRIFTING SWWD ACROSS EXTREME SWRN NM AND SLOWLY FILLING. THIS FEATURE SHOULD PROCEED SWWD OVER SONORA WHILE MERGING WITH PRE-EXISTING/SUBTROPICAL TROUGH ALREADY OVER WRN MEX. MEANWHILE...INITIALLY QUASI-ZONAL NRN-STREAM PATTERN IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MORE CYCLONIC IN CURVATURE AGAIN DURING PERIOD. THIS WILL OCCUR AS STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW ORBITING WRN SEMICIRCLE OF NUNAVUT/HUDSON BAY CYCLONE -- DIGS SEWD ACROSS NRN MB AND CONTRIBUTES TO HEIGHT FALLS ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL CANADA. THAT PROCESS WILL LEAD TO EWD ACCELERATION OF SHORTWAVE PERTURBATION NOW OVER SRN AB. LATTER FEATURE MAY DEAMPLIFY SLIGHTLY THROUGH PERIOD...BUT STILL SHOULD CONSIST OF WELL-DEFINED

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...WRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS NRN PARTS OF THIS REGION IS OCCURRING IN BROAD BELT OF ELEVATED LOW-LEVEL WAA AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT N OF SFC FRONT. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SHIFT NEWD THROUGH REMAINDER MORNING...BUT ALSO...MAY REINFORCE SFC BOUNDARY THROUGH OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING PROCESSES. ACCORDINGLY SHARPENED FRONTAL ZONE SHOULD SERVE AS PRIMARY FOCUS FOR DEVELOPMENT AND PROPAGATION OF SUBSEQUENT/AFTN CONVECTIVE EPISODE. INITIALLY ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP AMIDST HEIGHT FALLS ALOFT...STRENGTHENING OF SFC HEATING...INCREASING BUOYANCY...DIMINISHING CINH...AND FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL LIFT NEAR AND AHEAD OF SFC LOW. ACTIVITY MAY INITIALLY ASSUME BLEND OF MULTICELLULAR AND SUPERCELLULAR MODES...ESPECIALLY INVOF SFC BOUNDARY WHERE LOW-LEVEL SRH/VORTICITY IS MAXIMIZED...WITH LARGE HAIL...SVR GUSTS AND PERHAPS A COUPLE OF TORNADOES POSSIBLE. WITH TIME...ACTIVITY MAY AGGREGATE UPSCALE WITH POTENTIAL INCREASING FOR DAMAGING GUSTS...ESPECIALLY AWAY FROM SHALLOW BUT VERY STABLE LS MARINE LAYER THAT WILL INHIBIT BUT NOT ELIMINATE DCAPE. RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS IN PLACE ALONG AND S OF BOUNDARY WITH MLCAPE FCST TO RISE INTO 2000-3000 J/KG RANGE. ACTIVITY MAY SPREAD ESEWD A

sections.title: N-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS/BLACK HILLS REGION
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED AFTN TSTMS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTN IN AREAS WHERE HIGHER TERRAIN IS HEATED WITH CORRESPONDING WEAKENING OF CINH...FROM WY ROCKIES ENEWD ACROSS BLACK HILLS AREA. THIS REGIME WILL BE ON SRN EDGE OF WNWLY-NWLY MID-UPPER FLOW BELT...WITH WEAK TO MRGL DEEP SHEAR. ISOLATED HAIL AND GUSTS NEAR SVR LEVELS ARE POSSIBLE...WITH WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYERS EXPECTED.

sections.title: NERN CONUS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP THROUGH THIS AFTN AND EARLY EVENING...PRIMARILY MULTICELLULAR IN CHARACTER WITH OCCASIONAL LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS POSSIBLE. ALTHOUGH MID-UPPER SUPPORT WILL BE NEGLIGIBLE...GIVEN ABSENCE OF ANY SUBSTANTIAL PERTURBATIONS ALOFT...30-40 KT MIDLEVEL FLOW BELT WILL LEAD TO SUBTLE ENHANCEMENT OF DEEP SHEAR OVER THIS REGION. MEANWHILE...DIABATIC SFC HEATING OF BOUNDARY LAYER CONTAINING UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S F SFC DEW POINTS SHOULD LEAD TO FAVORABLE BUOYANCY AND PROGRESSIVELY WEAKENING CINH. POTENTIAL FOR ANY UPSCALE COLD-POOL GROWTH REMAINS UNCERTAIN ATTM AND LIKELY QUITE DEPENDENT ON STORM-SCALE PROCESSES...BUT WOULD ENHANCE DAMAGING-GUST POTENTIAL ON MESOSCALE IF IT BEGINS TO ORGANIZE. OTHERWISE...CONVECTION SHOULD DIMINISH SUBSTANTIALLY WITH EVENING/NOCTURNAL SFC COOLING. ....MS DELTA REGION AND CENTRAL-WRN GULF COAST... INITIALLY NON-SVR MULTICELLULAR TSTM CLUSTER OVER CENTRAL/SRN MS HAS BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED AND MAY BEGIN TO POSE THREAT FOR ISOLATED GUSTS NEAR SVR LEVELS...WITH ACCOMPANYING DAMAGE POSSIBILITIES...AS IT MOVES WSWWD INTO DIABATICALLY DESTABILIZING AND VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1420

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SURROUNDING THE MDT RISK AREA FROM THE NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY ESE TO THE LWR GRT LKS/NEW ENGLAND...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: EXPANSIVE FLAT RIDGE OVER THE CNTRL AND ERN U.S. WILL BE SUPPRESSED SLIGHTLY SWD THIS PERIOD AS STRONG TROUGH ON THE WRN SIDE OF HUDSON BAY VORTEX ADVANCES S/SE ACROSS NRN MB INTO NW ONT. FALLING HEIGHTS ON THE SRN FRINGE OF THE VORTEX WILL OVERSPREAD THE FAR NRN PLNS...THE UPR MS MS...AND THE UPR GRT LKS...INCREASING THE RISK FOR STRONG TO SVR TSTMS OVER THAT REGION AS WEAK SHORTWAVE IMPULSES ACCELERATE EWD IN STRENGTHENING WLY MID/UPR-LVL FLOW. ELSEWHERE...AN EASTERLY WAVE-TYPE DISTURBANCE WILL MOVE WWD ACROSS THE NRN GULF OF MEXICO IN TANDEM WITH A WEAK COLD-CORE IMPULSE THAT IN PART WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR YESTERDAYS STORMS IN THE CAROLINAS/GA. THE COMBINED TROUGH MAY ENHANCE THE POTENTIAL FOR STORMS TODAY OVER LA AND ADJACENT STATES.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: SFC WAVE NOW OVER ERN ND...AND ASSOCIATED WARM/STNRY FRONT EXTENDING E INTO THE UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS...SHOULD SERVE AS THE MAIN FOCUS FOR SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS PERIOD. THE FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE REINFORCED...AND ITS NWD ADVANCE SOMEWHAT RETARDED...BY PERSISTENT ELEVATED CONVECTION/STORMS ALONG THROUGH TNGT. THE BOUNDARY MAY ALSO SERVE AS THE MAIN FOCUS FOR LARGER-SCALE CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION/MCS DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR TNGT/EARLY FRI. IN THE MEAN TIME...WDLY SCTD TO SCTD TSTMS SHOULD FORM WITH SFC HEATING LATER TODAY NEAR ND SFC WAVE...EWD INTO NRN MN. GIVEN ENVIRONMENT OF STRONG BUOYANCY /MLCAPE AOA 3000 J PER KG/...FAVORABLE LOW-LVL UPLIFT...45-50 KT WLY DEEP SHEAR...AND INCREASING HEIGHT FALLS...SUSTAINED STORMS AND SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY...ESPECIALLY NEAR SFC FRONT WHERE LOW-LVL SRH WILL BE MAXIMIZED. LARGE HAIL...DMGG WINDS...AND A COUPLE TORNADOES MAY OCCUR. BY THIS EVE...DEGREE OF LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE...CONTINUED HEIGHT FALLS...AND NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING OF SWLY LLJ FAIRLY STRONGLY SUGGEST THAT THE STORMS WILL EVOLVE INTO A LARGER-SCALE CLUSTER OR LINE...WITH AN INCREASING RISK FOR DMGG OVER NRN/ERN MN AND WRN/NRN WI. WITH RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IN PLACE...THE

sections.text: STRONG SFC-BASED INSTABILITY...WITH MLCAPE OF 2500-3000 J/KG...SHOULD EXIST WITH SFC HEATING OVER NRN LWR MI...UPSTATE NY ...AND PARTS OF NRN/WRN NEW ENGLAND BY THIS AFTN. WHILE LARGE SCALE ASCENT LIKELY WILL BE WEAK /OR PERHAPS SLIGHTLY POSITIVE IN ASSOCIATION WITH PASSING MINOR DISTURBANCES IN SRN ONT-QUE/...30-35 KT WNWLY DEEP SHEAR WILL EXIST AS MODERATE 700-500 MB FLOW PERSISTS OVER THE REGION. LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE ALONG LAKE BOUNDARIES...TERRAIN CIRCULATIONS...AND SFC HEATING SHOULD PROMOTE SCTD STORM DEVELOPMENT BY MID AFTN. OTHER STORMS MAY MOVE INTO THE REGION LATER IN THE DAY FROM CANADA. GIVEN DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND LIKELIHOOD FOR STORM MERGERS...SETUP COULD YIELD A FEW STORM CLUSTERS WITH A RISK FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. FORWARD-PROPAGATING ACTIVITY MAY OCCUR AND EXTEND A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR STRONG TO SVR STORMS ESE INTO PARTS OF CNTRL/SRN NEW ENGLAND THIS EVE.

sections.text: ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD STORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTN ALONG SRN END OF SFC TROUGH EXTENDING SW FROM MN SFC LOW. DEVELOPMENT APPEARS MOST LIKELY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN WY...NW NEB...AND WRN SD...WHERE CIN WILL BE WEAKEST. MODEST WNW MID-LVL FLOW ON THE SRN EDGE OF WLYS MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT A FEW CELLS WITH SVR WIND/HAIL GIVEN WELL-MIXED SUB-CLOUD LAYER.

sections.title: AR/LA/E TX AND VICINITY THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: WWD MOVING DISTURBANCE SHOULD MOVE ACROSS THE LWR MS VLY/NW GULF TODAY. WIND PROFILES INVOF THE FEATURE ARE NOT AS STRONG AS YESTERDAY...BUT REMAIN FAIRLY UNIDIRECTIONAL IN THE LOW TO MID-TROPOSPHERE. THOSE WINDS ARE...HOWEVER...CARRYING CLOUD DEBRIS WWD AHEAD OF THE OVERNIGHT CONVECTIVE SYSTEM THAT FORMED IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE DISTURBANCE. WHILE THIS COMPLICATES THE FORECAST...IT APPEARS THAT UPLIFT ALONG THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM GUST FRONT...AND/OR DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG THE PERIPHERY OF THE MCS...SHOULD PROMOTE A NEW ROUND OF SCTD STRONG STORMS DOWNSTREAM ACROSS PARTS OF AR/LA/E TX....AND PERHAPS W TN/SE MO/W KY. ISOLD WET MICROBURSTS MAY OCCUR GIVEN HI PWS AND STRONGLY HEATED/WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT AWAY FROM EXISTING STORMS. ..CORFIDI/MOSIER.. 07/18/2013

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY TO LAKE WESTERN NY
sections.text: CONSIDERABLE VEERING AND WEAK LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE APPEAR TO BE PARTLY RESPONSIBLE FOR LACK OF STRONG CONVECTION ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY THIS EVENING. ORGANIZED DEEP CONVECTION HAS STRUGGLED TO INTENSIFY AHEAD OF WEAK SFC LOW OVER THE ARROWHEAD OF MN BUT APPROACHING SHORT-WAVE TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO AID DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS EVENING NEAR THE CANADIAN BORDER. HAVE OPTED TO LOWER SEVERE PROBS ACROSS MN/WI DUE TO THE STRUGGLING NATURE OF THIS CONVECTION BUT TSTMS ARE STILL ANTICIPATED TO DEVELOP SWWD ALONG THE COLD FRONT WHICH SHOULD THEN SPREAD EAST ACROSS THE U.P. OF MI LATE TONIGHT. DOWNSTREAM...A WELL ORGANIZED BAND OF TSTMS HAVE EVOLVED WITHIN WEAK WARM ADVECTION ZONE ACROSS THE ERN U.P. INTO ONTARIO. THIS ACTIVITY IS SPREADING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 35KT AND IF CONVECTION CAN REMAIN ORGANIZED IT MAY SPREAD ACROSS LAKE ONTARIO INTO WRN NY AROUND SUNRISE. 00Z SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO NRN LOWER MI REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR MAINTENANCE OF ANY ORGANIZED BANDS OF CONVECTION THAT EVOLVE ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT...THUS DAMAGING WINDS MAY BE THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT THE REST OF THE PERIOD. ..DARROW.. 07/19/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A FEW SVR TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. A WW IS POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT TERM...THOUGH MORE LIKELY AS THE AFTN PROGRESSES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INTENSE DIURNAL HEATING IS RESULTING IN STRONG INSTABILITY ACROSS WRN NY AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF LAKES ERIE AND ONTARIO WITH MLCAPES OF 3000 J/KG OR HIGHER AND NEGLIGIBLE CINH. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY REVEALS AN EXPANDING CU FIELD WITH SOME ENHANCEMENT THAT SUGGESTS TSTM DEVELOPMENT MAY BEGIN IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. THIS REGION IS ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF STRONGER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...HOWEVER WITH AROUND 25-30 KTS OF 0-6 KM SHEAR...ORGANIZED MULTICELLS ARE EXPECTED AS THE PRIMARY CONVECTIVE MODE. INSTABILITY COUPLED WITH PW VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1.7 INCHES SUGGESTS DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT...WITH LARGE HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS. A WW IS POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT TERM...AND MORE LIKELY LATER THIS AFTN AS ORGANIZED TSTMS UPSTREAM POTENTIALLY IMPACT THIS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED TO FOSTER WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WHILE THE OVERALL SVR THREAT IS LOW...A FEW STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BASED ON SATELLITE IMAGERY...OVERNIGHT TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS AL APPEARS TO HAVE RESULTED IN AN AREA OF CONVECTIVELY-INDUCED VORTICITY...WHICH LIKELY EXTENDS FROM SRN MS NEWD THROUGH NW AL AND INTO SRN MIDDLE TN. THERE ALSO APPEARS TO BE AN MCV WITHIN THE LARGER AREA OF ENHANCED VORTICITY IN THE VICINITY OF CBM IN NE MS. THESE FEATURES SHOULD PROVIDE ENOUGH LIFT TO GENERATE WIDESPREAD TSTMS THROUGHOUT THE LWR MS VALLEY. BOUNDARY LAYER IS GENERALLY CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN MID 80S TO UPPER 90S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S. WHILE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES REMAIN RATHER MARGINAL...DIURNAL HEATING SHOULD QUICKLY RESULT IN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 8 DEG C PER KM. THIS HEATING IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE MOISTURE SHOULD RESULT IN SUFFICIENT 0-3 KM MLCAPE FOR STRONG PULSE CONVECTION CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. MESOANALYSIS ALREADY INDICATES 0-3 KM MLCAPE AROUND 100-150 J/KG. HOWEVER...SHEAR IS WEAK AND THE OVERALL SVR THREAT IS LOW. THIS AREA WILL BE MONITORED BUT A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE DURING THE AFTN HOURS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL LIKELY. A WW IS PSBL IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...AND MORE LIKELY LATER THIS AFTN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLD SVR TSTM OVER MONTMORENCY COUNTY MI WILL CONTINUE MOVING ESE TOWARDS AREAS NEAR/S OF ALPENA WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. THE ENVIRONMENT OVER NRN LOWER MI IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE AS SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 80S/LOWER 90S...AND ADDITIONAL DIURNAL HEATING WILL LEAD TO FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WITH TIME. FAIRLY UNIDIRECTIONAL LOW AND MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL RESULT IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED TSTMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY LARGE HAIL. EXPECT ADDITIONAL TSTMS TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA THIS AFTN...WITH MERGERS LEADING TO E/SEWD-MOVING LINES/BOWING SEGMENTS. A WW IS PSBL PRIOR TO 19Z...AND MORE LIKELY BEYOND THAT TIME AS ORGANIZED TSTMS DEVELOP UPSTREAM AND MOVE TOWARDS NRN LOWER MI.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTN...EVENTUALLY FORMING LINES/BOWING SEGMENTS WITH THE RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO. ONE OR MORE WW ISSUANCES WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED FOR PORTIONS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA PRIOR TO 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE BEEN INCREASING IN INTENSITY OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS OVER THE MN ARROWHEAD/ADJACENT LAKE SUPERIOR...AND ALSO OVER THE CENTRAL MI UPPER PENINSULA. A WARM FRONT EXTENDS EWD ACROSS NRN MN AND LAKE SUPERIOR WITH SUBSTANTIAL DIURNAL HEATING SOUTH OF THE FRONT RESULTING IN MODERATE TO STRONG SFC-BASED INSTABILITY. 35-40 KTS OF MID-LEVEL FLOW HAS RESULTED IN 0-6 KM SHEAR SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT A MIX OF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND LINES/BOWING SEGMENTS AS THE AFTN PROGRESSES. BOTH OF THESE AREAS OF TSTMS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF INCREASING ORGANIZATION AND ACCELERATING FORWARD SPEEDS WHICH WOULD REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE. FARTHER WEST ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL MN...WEAK RIDGING ALOFT CURRENTLY APPEARS TO BE IN PLACE...AND THIS SHOULD GIVE WAY TO INCREASING FORCING FOR ASCENT AS AN IMPULSE DROPS SEWD FROM MANITOBA/WRN ONTARIO LATER THIS AFTN/EVENING. TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED IN THIS REGION WITH INITIALLY DISCRETE SUPERCELLS WITH A RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH IS POSSIBLE WITH A CONTINUED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT LATER THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH A CONTINUED SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT. A WW IS PSBL PRIOR TO 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCTD STG/SVR TSTMS CONTINUE ACROSS AN AREA FROM ST LAWRENCE COUNTY NY SEWD ACROSS CENTRAL VT...SERN NH AND SRN MAINE. THIS AREA IS ALONG A WARM FRONTAL SEGMENT AND CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 40-50 KTS OF DEEP SHEAR. EXPECT TSTMS TO CONTINUE TO POSE A SVR WIND THREAT GIVEN STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND PW VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1.5 INCHES. OVERALL HAIL THREAT WILL BE TEMPERED SOMEWHAT BY WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES BUT A FEW REPORTS ARE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR MID-LEVEL ROTATION. TSTMS SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING GENERALLY ESEWD THROUGH EARLY EVENING ...OCNLY MERGING INTO CLUSTERS WITH A MORE CONCENTRATED WIND THREAT. A WW IS PSBL PRIOR TO 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WHILE THE OVERALL SVR THREAT IS LOW...A FEW OF THESE STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. GIVEN THE EXPECTED LOW COVERAGE AND INTENSITY...A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES CONVECTIVE INITIATION MAY OCCUR SHORTLY ALONG A THERMALLY-ENHANCED TROUGH EXTENDING SWWD FROM A SURFACE LOW IN NW MN. THUS FAR...ONGOING TSTM ACTIVITY HAS BEEN ANCHORED TO THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE BLACK HILLS...QUICKLY DISSIPATING AS IT MOVES SWD. HOWEVER...BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES AS TEMPERATURES CLIMB INTO THE MID TO UPPER 90S AMIDST A MODESTLY MOIST ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 50S. MESOANALYSIS INDICATES THE AREA IS STILL UNDER SOME CINH...WHICH SEEMS LIKELY GIVEN THE WARMER TEMPERATURES ALOFT. CONTINUED HEATING SHOULD ERODE THE CINH WITH AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE. GIVEN THAT THIS AREA IS ON THE SRN EDGE OF THE ENHANCED MID-LEVEL FLOW...0-6 KM BULK SHEAR VALUES WILL LIKELY REMAIN AOB 35 KT AND STORM ORGANIZATION WILL BE MARGINAL. AS SUCH...THE OVERALL SVR THREAT IS LOW BUT ANY STORMS THAT DO DEVELOP MAY BE CAPABLE OF A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS GIVEN THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS ON THE ORDER OF 40 DEG F. ONLY ISOLATED SVR COVERAGE AND MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THE EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL...SRN AND POTENTIALLY SERN PA. THE LACK OF GREATER STORM COVERAGE/ ORGANIZATION PRECLUDES THE NEED FOR A WATCH. THE OVERALL THREAT FOR TSTMS AND ISOLATED SVR POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO DIMINISH AFTER SUNSET WITH THE LOSS OF DAY TIME HEATING RESULTING IN AN INCREASE IN SURFACE BASED INHIBITION/BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2220Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BAND OF CONVECTION EXTENDING FROM THE NORTH CENTRAL PA/SOUTH CENTRAL NY BORDER /INVOF BRADFORD COUNTY/ WSWWD TO CLINTON COUNTY AND WWD TO CLARION COUNTY. THE STRONGEST STORMS WERE LOCATED IN SRN CLINTON/LYCOMING COUNTIES AND IN ERN CLARION/NRN JEFFERSON COUNTIES...WITH SOME LINEAR STRUCTURE OBSERVED IN THE FORMER COUNTIES FROM 5 W KIPT TO 20 NE KUNV. ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS ONLY AROUND 20 KT /LIMITING GREATER POTENTIAL FOR STORM ORGANIZATION/...THE PRESENCE OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE UP TO 3000-3500 J PER KG/ RESIDING ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE ONGOING TSTMS AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. SEWD STORM MOVEMENT AT 15-20 KT SUGGESTS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL AND SRN PA WILL BE AFFECTED BY TSTMS INTO THE EARLY EVENING...WITH THIS SCENARIO SUPPORTED BY A FEW HIGH RES CONVECTION ALLOWING MODELS. THE HIGH CAPE/LOWER SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE WITH STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL TEND TO AID IN THE PRODUCTION OF A FEW STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...ESPECIALLY IF A COLD POOL OR TWO CAN DEVELOP. OTHERWISE...GIVEN THE VERY STRONG INSTABILITY...A FEW HAIL EVENTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY DEVELOP AND POSE AT LEAST A MODEST THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND OVER PORTIONS OF NCNTRL AND NERN ND INTO NWRN MN THIS EVENING. UNCERTAINTY STILL EXISTS REGARDING THE EXTENT OF THREAT AND WHETHER OR NOT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED...BUT AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATES A COLD FRONT FROM NWRN MN SWWD INTO SRN ND. A SECONDARY FRONTAL SURGE AND PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY WAS INDICATED FROM SWRN MANITOBA INTO NWRN ND. THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS QUITE UNSTABLE ACROSS THE ERN HALF OF ND INTO NWRN MN WHERE TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 ARE CONTRIBUTING TO 2000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE. LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE WLY OVER MUCH OF THE WARM SECTOR WITH LIMITED CONVERGENCE. HOWEVER...WV IMAGERY SHOWS A LOW AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER SRN SASKATCHEWAN AND SWRN MANITOBA...AND THIS FEATURE WILL CONTINUE ESEWD TOWARD NERN ND THIS EVENING. ZONE OF DPVA/ASCENT JUST AHEAD OF THIS IMPULSE MAY SUPPORT STORMS DEVELOPING A BIT FARTHER SOUTH INTO NERN ND ALONG FRONT OR PRE-FRONTAL CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY. WLY UNIDIRECTIONAL VERTICAL SHEAR FROM 40-50 KT SUPPORTS POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELL SPLITS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREATS. GIVEN SOMEWHAT LIMITED CONVERGENCE DUE THE WLY FLOW REGIME AND LIKELIHOOD THAT STRONGER FORCING WILL REMAIN NORTH OF THE U.S. BORDER UNTIL AFTER SUNSET WHEN THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BEGIN TO STABILIZE...SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING EXTENT OF SEVERE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT ACROSS MUCH OF WW 420 WILL PROBABLY REMAIN SOMEWHAT LIMITED DURING THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. HOWEVER...SOME POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STORMS TO BE REINVIGORATED LATER THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS EVENING A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS ACROSS EXTREME NRN MN TO A WEAK SURFACE LOW THEN SWWD AS A WEAK COLD FRONT THROUGH NWRN MN AND SERN ND. THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE IN THIS REGION WITH AROUND 2000 J/KG MLCAPE. ONGOING CONVECTION WITH A COUPLE OF SEVERE STORMS PERSIST ACROSS THE ARROWHEAD REGION. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS A THERMAL RIDGE AT 850-700 MB IN THE WARM SECTOR SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY...AND WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING SURFACE BASED CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS INCREASING. SATELLITE TRENDS SHOW BOUNDARY LAYER CUMULUS DIMINISHING ALONG PORTION OF FRONT OVER NWRN MN. THIS SUGGESTS PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT NEXT HOUR OR TWO WILL REMAIN ALONG QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT OVER NERN ND. HOWEVER...DEEPER FORCING ATTENDING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH DROPPING ESEWD INTO NRN ND MAY EVENTUALLY INTERCEPT THIS BOUNDARY...POSSIBLY CONTRIBUTING TO A RE-INVIGORATION OF STORMS OVER PORTIONS OF NWRN MN LATER THIS EVENING. ..DIAL.. 07/19/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BROKEN LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TRACKING ESEWD THIS EVENING...AFFECTING ERN UPPER MI AND FAR NRN LOWER MI. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS. COUNTIES AND MARINE ZONES LOCATED NORTH OF THE ONGOING STORMS CAN BE CANCELLED FROM WW 421.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 02Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM ERN UPPER MI ENEWD TO FAR NRN LAKE HURON AND DRUMMOND ISLAND TO THE NORTH CHANNEL AND ADJACENT ONTARIO. THIS LINE OF STORMS WAS MOVING ESEWD AT 30-35 KT WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. HOWEVER...TRENDS IN OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED AN INCREASE IN SURFACE BASED INHIBITION SUGGESTING AN EVENTUAL WANING IN STORM INTENSITY. THIS WANING TREND HAS BEEN NOTED IN IR SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWING SOME WARMING OF CLOUD TOPS OVER ERN UPPER MI AND REDUCTION IN UPDRAFT STRENGTHS PER WEAKENING TREND WITH 9 KM CAPPI DATA. STRONGER CORES WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE SOME POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZATION GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF 35-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. ..PETERS.. 07/19/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL AFFECT PORTION OF NRN MN INTO WRN LAKE SUPERIOR INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD...WITH SOME ACTIVITY POTENTIALLY BECOMING SEVERE. HOWEVER...THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE GREAT ENOUGH TO SUPPORT A NEW WW ISSUANCE...AND THUS WW 420 WILL LIKELY EXPIRE AS SCHEDULED AT 05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0435Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS CONTINUING ACROSS NERN MN INTO WRN LAKE SUPERIOR WITH A COUPLE OF STORMS AFFECTING NWRN MN AS WELL. OVERALL TRENDS IN COVERAGE OF STRONGER STORMS/SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS HAS BEEN DIMINISHING LATE THIS EVENING AS THE STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT HAS BEEN LOCATED TO THE NORTH OF MN WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY CENTERED OVER SERN MANITOBA AND ADJACENT ONTARIO. THIS IMPULSE WILL PROGRESS EWD OVERNIGHT...WITH THE STRONGEST ASCENT LIKELY REMAINING JUST N OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER. A LONE STORM OVER NRN BELTRAMI COUNTY COULD PERSIST EWD AS IT IS SUPPORTED BY THE SRN EXTENT OF THE AFOREMENTIONED IMPULSE. FARTHER E...LIGHTNING TRENDS HAVE CONTINUED TO DIMINISH OVER NERN MN SUGGESTING THE OVERALL THREAT FOR STRONGER STORMS WILL FURTHER WANE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY DIMINISH AS A SMALL LINE SEGMENT OVER CNTRL UPPER MI MOVES EWD AND BECOMES INCREASINGLY ELEVATED ATOP AN AIR MASS STABILIZED BY REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FLARE-UP IN INTENSITY OF BOTH VELOCITY AND REFLECTIVELY OCCURRED NEAR MQT AS A SHORT-LINE SEGMENT MERGED WITH A RECENT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT HAD BEEN SAGGING SWD IN CNTRL UPPER MI. THIS YIELDED A 43 KT MEASURED WIND GUST AT KSAW AT 0934Z. DOWNSTREAM...CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW HAD REACHED NRN LOWER MI EARLIER THIS MORNING BEFORE DIMINISHING. MUCH OF ERN UPPER MI HAD BEEN COOLED IN THE WAKE OF THE INITIAL OUTFLOW...WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES PRIMARILY IN THE MIDDLE TO UPPER 60S. IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT THE RECENT FLARE-UP COULD BE SHORT-LIVED GIVEN THE COOLER DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS. NEVERTHELESS...PRESENCE OF 50-60 KT WLYS AS LOW AS 1 KM AGL DOES RENDER CONCERN FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS.
